ns2:course.label: Ballet II
ns2:course.description: Progressive development of the concepts and skills in DANC 107; for the non-dance major. May be repeated to a maximum of 4 hours. Prerequisite: Two semesters of DANC 107 or equivalent or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 4 hours. Prerequisite: Two semesters of DANC 107 or equivalent or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: For non-dance majors. Student costs for supplies and concert tickets are approx. $30. Written assignments and concert attendance is required.
